results.target_engagement_evidence: Demonstrated improvements in multiple photoprotective behaviors including increased use of long sleeves, long pants, and shade-seeking
biomarker_changes: Reduced UV exposure measured by dosimeter (-1.38 J/m²)
Decreased melanin index in children indicating less tanning
Reduced unprotected sun exposure time in parents
subgroup_findings: Parents showed greater improvement in protective clothing use than sunscreen application
Children maintained sunscreen use but improved protective clothing behaviors
Both parents and children increased skin self-examination thoroughness
